title.prompt:
Edit this K4RMA main menu to feel fuller, more distinctive and more finished while keeping approved clean minimal moonlit hand drawn indie-game style. SAME navy indigo teal palette, simple cel shadows, layered mountain mist, sparse vegetation, exact small black ponytailed hero navy clothing ivory sash katana. Keep readable airy text menu, no new text, no panels or buttons.
Give the TITLE a stronger designed presence: exact "K4RMA" same left upper position, make lettering a little heavier and less hairline, elegant handcrafted serif with subtle taper; slightly increased size about10%, coherent spacing, faint tiny pale moonlight edge. Replace small generic underline with a single refined thin asymmetrical moonlight brush crescent gracefully threading behind/below the logo, subtle enough that letters remain clear, two slender tapering lines, not a big fight slash or halo.
Give right half an architectural focal vignette: reveal more of the original Japanese dojo roof and veranda at right, occupying rightmost25-30%, strong graceful broad roof silhouette, few wooden beams and quiet shoji window with VERY dim warm light. No fancy pagoda ornament, no new trees.
